messages:
Sam: Quick thread for NovaGen QBR prep 1: credit runway alarm this morning. Need a 30d forecast + mitigation list. Elaine can you run the forecast? Tess, quick throttles or batching options? Marta, own the optimization session. Jordan, hold any promo-credit escalation.

Elaine: On it 1 running short 30d->30d forecast now. Will return three scenarios (status quo, -10% quick wins, -25% optimized) and convert tokens->credits->USD. ETA 25m.

Tess: Observed many small embedding calls causing poor batching. Quick mitigation: soft RPM throttle for embeddings for 48-72h + enable prefix cache for repeated contexts. Draft throttle config below.

Tess: throttle:
  max_rpm: 50
  window: 72h
  rollback_if: errors_rate > 0.5%

Marta: I'll run a 45m optimization session. Draft agenda: usage anatomy, live batching tweaks, prefix cache demo, post-session PR template. Deliverable: 1-page playbook. EOD.

Elaine: Forecast results: continuation runway ~10 days; -10% -> ~11.5 days; -25%+batching -> ~16 days. Conversion: 1k tokens ~= 3 credits; 1 credit ~= $0.0045. CSV+chart attached to packet.

Sam: Great. Action items: Elaine (CSV/chart) 25m, Tess (throttle playbook) 30m, Marta (session + PR template) EOD, Jordan (escalation) on-call. I'll assemble QBR packet once Elaine posts.

Jordan: If forecast <14d I will escalate for a 1-month top-up. If 14-30d, I'll approve a 2-week discretionary buffer.

Sam: Thanks team :thumbsup:
